content.text: All checks pass. Written to `docs/paper/method.tex` (911 words including markup). The section defines all notation referenced by experiments.tex ($k$, CV, SR, $M$, $N$), includes Table 1 (`\label{tab:model_properties}`) with 6 models grouped by eval protocol and ordered by CV, and uses all required labels (`sec:method`, `sec:models`, `sec:pruning_protocol`, `sec:cv_diagnostic`, `sec:vtr`).
